name: DockNest Self-Hosted Docker Backup
free_limit: Free AGPL-3.0 self-hosted Docker and nginx site backup/restore dashboard with per-site schedules, encrypted SFTP or S3-compatible backups, and recovery-point verification; no software usage quota published.
watch_out: Beta software: automatic recovery after server reboot is not production-ready; restore-test support is limited and must be independently validated. Requires your own Linux Docker host, SSH access to target servers, backup storage and capacity; storage/provider costs are not included. Protect master encryption keys and backup access.
